experiment_data.hypothesis: Qwen-14B KL 30% s42 eval under TEAL uniform allocation will produce comparable downstream metrics to s123/s456 (also uniform), enabling valid 3-seed comparison. Retry of v1 which failed due to missing HF offline env vars (network unreachable). v2 adds HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.
